content: Bab-Dummad-Burba anmarga nue ise-sogar imaknaid. Anmarga soged, ibagan bergudanikile, bukidar Bab-Igargi bangudmaloye. Ar amarde, burba-isgana-dule-yardakmaladba akadmaloed, degi, niamar-igar-odurdakmaladba nadmaloed.

We-dulemarde, dulemar-wagar-darbo-damalad-itodmaloed, degi, dulemar-gakansaerbamalad itodmarbaloed. Ar we-odurdakmaladde e-ulubgi igar-isgana-imaknair, esgoro-uedgi wilubgan-nasiklegeyob, gwen bai itogosurmalad.

A-dulemarde noar odurdakmalad. Sogdamaloed: “Machergan mer ome-nikumaloye. Omeganmo, mer machergan-nikumarmogoye.” Degine, sogdamarbaloed: “Mas gwen-gwen ise gulleye.” Ar ade, Bab-Dummad mas obinnissursi, adi, Bab-Jesúsʼgi-bensurmalad, igar-napiragwad-wismalad mas gunmalagar.
Ar Bab-Dummad-bela-ibmar-obinnisadi, ibmar-nueganbiid. Degisoggu, ar Bab-Dummadga-dogdar-nuedye-soglegedgi, ibmar-abingaleger, gwen oballege-wilubsulid. Bela abingalege-wilubbiid.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Gayaburbagi, degi, Bab-Dummadse-goledgi we-ibmar bela swilidik gued.

Ar be we-igargi gwenadgan-odurdakele, be Jesucristoʼga-arbaed-nuedga guoed. Bab-Dummad-e-gayaburba-nued-bensulidgi na be nasgumai-gumogoed, degine, igar-nuegan-maidba-daedba be nasgumai gudbaloed. Ar be we-igar-nuegan-durdaksadba be nanadimogad.
Mer we-napneggi-binsa-nabir-nue-sunmaklemalad be itogo, degi, mer be binsa-igar-onolegedgi-sunmakmaladgi binsabalo. Bab-Dummad-sabedbali e-igargi-dobekwaa-nanaedgi be alamaknai gusun.
Ar abaganmar-ogannolegedi igar-nuedindo, degi-inigwele, ulubgi-burba-ogannoleged bur-igar-nuedid. We-burba-ogannoleged, emisgwa-gudiguedgarbisulid, yoedse Bab-neggi-gudii guedgarbalid.
We-igar napiragwadid, bela dulemar benguewilubsurmalad, bela abingaewilubmalad.

Ar a-ular, anmar dulemar-anmargi-urwed-abargi, Bab-Igargi alamaknaimarsunnad. Ar anmarde, Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maidginbi bensuli edarbedimalad. Ar Bab-Dummad bela dulemar-abonoged maid. Bur bule, dulemar-egi-bensurmalad-bendakmaid.
We-ibmar an bega sogsadyob, be Bab-Jesúsʼgi-bensurmaladga sogmogoed, deyob be odurdakbaloed.
Be sapingwagwad-ular, mer dulemar ibgwensur-be-dakega be imako. Aka bur gwenadgan-Jesúsʼba-nanaimaladga na be-daed-nued be oyogoed,
Timoteo, an-bese-nadapoedse, gwenadganga gatik be Bab-Dummad-Garda absogo, gatik be gwenadgan-ogannogo, degi, gatik be gwenadgan-odurdakbalo.
Bab-Dummad bega-gurgin-nued-uksadi be nue ebugo, ar wede bega uklesad. Deun, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-e-idumalad-danar-bukwa Bab-Dummad-sogedba na e-arganmar be-nonogi mesismargu, bega uklesad.
We igargan an-bega-sogsadginbi be gatik alamaknai sao. Aginbi be nanao, adi, baigan Bab-Jesús-Igargi be-nasgumaid mag be-dakmalagar.

Timoteo, nue-salakar, be-daed nued-oyodii be guo. Deginbali, be-ibmar-odurdaked nuekwaa be odurdakdii gubalo. Ar deyob be imakele, na be san-bendakoed. Deginbali, dulemar-be-itodimalad be bendakbaloed.
